scope.summary: Build the genital config panel per Section 13.27 GUI clauses: cock/pussy/anus channel sliders at the same grain as every other region — no special-casing, no extra friction — plus erection state (continuum + rigid/floppy), gape dials including the extreme range, and the arousal controller, all labeled in direct production language (MT-601 surface; REQ-030..032, PREQ-013).
acceptance_criteria: Penis channels (length/girth/curve/taper, glans, foreskin continuum, vein intensity, scrotum), vulva channels (labia size/shape/spread, clit, gape incl. extreme, canal depth), and anus channels render as standard sliders identical in grain and interaction to any body region — no special confirmation dialogs, no segregated mode.
Erection continuum slider plus rigid|floppy state toggle and gape dials drive the same channel ops as configure_genitals (asserted equivalence).
The arousal controller slider live-drives flush/engorgement/wetness/nipple-erection preview in the viewport (MT-559 hook).
Labels use direct language (cock, pussy, gape, erection) matching the channel registry ids; no euphemistic renaming layer exists.
All controls carry stable author_ids; Argus sets an erection state and captures the result headlessly; futa configs show both modules' panels concurrently without conflict.
scope.risk_if_missed: Special-casing or euphemizing the primary production surface adds exactly the friction and second-class treatment that pushed this content into Daz's aftermarket-graft ghetto — the anti-pattern BodyKit is designed against.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: BodyKit GUI must expose or integrate the geometry/morph, joint, weight/rigidity, transfer, skin/material, interlink, Jobs, Problems, history, recovery, and shared-world contracts.
